label: Command bar — open tabs, commands, history, search
note: ⌘⇧B belongs to the command bar. New-browser remains key-less: the ⌘N chooser and the command bar itself reach it.

label: Duplicate this tab
note: Moved off ⌘⇧D because ⌘D and ⌘⇧D are the terminal split pair. The first replacement, ⌘⌥D, was free but unreachable: the global handler returns on ⌥ chords and page key tables do not receive them. A shortcut must be checked against dispatch behavior, not only the list of occupied keys.

label: Join a remote tab by ticket
Share the whole app…
note: Sharing the entire interface is deliberate and rare, so the command bar is its only entrance and a mispressed shortcut cannot start it. A tab's own share keeps its dialog.

label: Stop sharing the app
note: Key-less: the stop lives with the ticket panel; this row is the same hand's other half.

label: Close the open file, or the tab when none is open
Downloads — files this browser saved
note: Key-less like new-browser and reachable from the command bar and View menu. ⌘⇧J is taken by join, and a near-synonym key would be worse than none.

label: Find — in the terminal, the editor, or the page
note: Dispatched contextually by the global handler: the terminal and the code editor each run their own search, so only a browser tab routes this to the shared find command. The key is this one wherever it is answered.

label: Split the terminal into two side by side
note: The five rows below are local pane controls: they act on the terminal in front and mean nothing on browser or file tabs, so the app-wide handler must not answer them. ⌘D creates a vertical divider with panes side by side.

label: Split the terminal into two stacked
Move to the pane left / right / above / below
Zoom this pane to fill the tab, or put it back
Move this pane's edge left / right / up / down
Type into every pane of this terminal at once
note: Broadcast input is a switch, not a mode. On, one keystroke reaches every pane of the tab; off, only the focused pane. It is deliberately local to the terminal in front.

label: Terminal panel in a file tab
Address bar / jump to a directory
Open this page in the default browser
Print the current page
note: Printing is key-less because ⌘P belongs to the switcher. Use File ▸ Print… or the command bar.
